desc: Read the input string $S$ from standard input.
Construct the auxiliary string $T$ by concatenating $S$, a unique separator character (e.g., '#'), and the reverse of $S$.
Compute the KMP failure function (pi array) for the string $T$.
Determine the length of the longest prefix of $\text{reverse}(S)$ that matches a suffix of $S$ using the last value of the pi array.
Construct the final palindrome by appending the necessary characters from $\text{reverse}(S)$ to $S$ and print the result to standard output.
Implement the KMP algorithm to compute the $\pi$ array for the string $T = S + \# + S[::-1]$.
Extract the length of the longest matching suffix from the last element of the $\pi$ array.
Construct the result by appending the necessary characters from $S[::-1]$ to $S$.
Handle edge cases (e.g., single character, already palindrome) naturally via the algorithm.
Wrap the logic in a function and ensure fast I/O.
Verify the solution against provided sample inputs.
Check for potential memory limits or recursion depth issues (none expected with iterative KMP).
